meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India
meta.coverage: Select financial ratios of scheduled commercial banks by bank group, each year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1056 (data provider DP1), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Final figures where published, else provisional. Business and profit per employee are left out: the table switches their unit from year to year (all banks' business per employee 173,638 in 2014, 20,187 in 2015, 1,413,244 in 2020) and prints no unit.
